assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia.
The diagnosis of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation is I48.0.
The diagnosis of supraventricular tachycardia is I47.1.
The ICD-10 code R42 documents the symptom of giddiness.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptomatic complaints of dizziness.
The CPT code for mobile cardiac telemetry is 93229.
This extended monitoring will assist in confirming the diagnosis and guiding appropriate rate or rhythm control therapy.
The payer's denial reason code is CO-197.
The denial asserts that the required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
The clinical indication establishes clear medical necessity for this diagnostic procedure to manage a symptomatic arrhythmia.
